| description = I believe he was eventually renamed to Captain Surestout on live, which may cause some confusion in certain areas. There are 3 other NPC's in camp here, a Lvl 20 (Rogue) Dark Elf Female [[Dixl Drool]], Lvl 17 Gnomish Magician [[Toko Binlittle]], and a level 27 Barbarian [[a buccaneer]]. Nearby is also [[Gornit]] in the water, and [[Quag Maelstrom]] paths near the camp also.

Shaman Epic note: coming from Freeport, if you jump off the boat when you see his island (around -150, -5250,) you can kill him, and the Dark Elf who will join, and still swim over to the Island of the Sisters of Erollisi, to catch the boat coming from the east, from Butcherblock.  Levitate will serve you well.  Binding yourself in Freeport before you leave will serve you even better.
